title: Martin F. Helmke, PhD, PG
text:
I am a professor of hydrogeology in the Department of Earth and Space Sciences at West Chester University of Pennsylvania, and a licensed Professional Geologist 30+ years of consulting experience.
My work emphasizes fractured-rock hydrogeology, contaminant fate and transport modeling, engineering geology, and applied geophysics.
Extracurricular interests include Greenland-style sea kayaking, ultramarathon running, and exploring Earth with my beautiful and adventurous family.

Teaching
I regularly teach undergraduate and graduate courses in hydrogeology, soils, and applied geoscience, with an emphasis on quantitative reasoning, field methods, and reproducible analysis.
